environment.native_backend_evidence: Separate capability probe outside measured calls; the adapter does not expose a per-inference GPU measurement.
environment.memory_measurement: System capacity only; no peak process-group RAM or GPU-memory measurement.

methodology.stop_rule: Stop a model after three consecutive invalid/error responses; record actual and skipped calls. Incorrect but valid answers do not trigger this rule.
methodology.latency_boundary: LocalRunner.decide wall time, including its manifest lookup, adaptation, model work and worker IPC; excludes response validation, HTTP, downloads and hash verification.
methodology.first_call_boundary: Fresh LocalRunner, not a cold machine: verification has read weights into OS file caches; parent runtime/JIT and OS caches are not reset.
methodology.percentile_method: nearest rank, ceil(p*n)-1 in sorted elapsed times
methodology.quality_scope: Twenty authored synthetic form-action cases. This small public sanity check does not establish general model quality.
methodology.raw_answers: Only the fixed public synthetic fixture is accepted. No private inputs, config, credentials or hosted calls are read.

models.usage_semantics: UTF-8 byte option scoring without generation; protocol token counters are 0 and token throughput is not applicable.
models.repeated_state: Same runner and resident model after two warmups.

summary.accuracy_denominator: unique_first_pass_cases is the observed denominator; a complete pass contains 20 authored cases. Failures count as incorrect. Repeats are not independent examples.

models.usage_semantics: Native token usage is not exposed by this adapter; protocol 0/0 counters do not mean zero token work.
models.repeated_state: New engine process for every request; no resident-model warm result.

summary.accuracy_denominator: unique_first_pass_cases is the observed denominator; a complete pass contains 20 authored cases. Failures count as incorrect. Repeats are not independent examples.

models.usage_semantics: Actual fully wrapped prompt tokens, separately evaluated per question; output_tokens=0 means no generated text returned, not no computation.
models.repeated_state: Same runner and resident model after two warmups.
